name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
description: Centrally sponsored maternity benefit programme providing direct financial assistance to pregnant women and lactating mothers for wage compensation and health nutrition.
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
department: Department of Women and Child Development
target_beneficiaries: Pregnant women and lactating mothers aged 19 years and above for first living child, and for second child if it is a girl child, from socially and economically disadvantaged backgrounds
benefits: Cash incentive of Rs. 5,000 in two instalments for first child, and Rs. 6,000 in a single instalment for second child if girl child, transferred directly via DBT into Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

source_evidence.statement: Administered by the Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India under Mission Shakti.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development
source_evidence.citation: Mission Shakti - Samarthya PMMVY Guidelines Section 1

source_evidence.statement: Centrally sponsored maternity entitlement scheme implemented across all States and UTs.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development

source_evidence.statement: Pregnant women and lactating mothers who are socially and economically disadvantaged (SC/ST, differently abled, BPL/EWS, PMJAY/e-Shram beneficiaries).
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development

source_evidence.statement: Rs. 5,000 for first child in 2 tranches (ANC registration and childbirth with immunization); Rs. 6,000 for second girl child.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development

source_evidence.statement: Official beneficiary self-registration and Anganwadi portal hosted at pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development

source_evidence.statement: PMMVY 2.0 operational with complete digital application and DBT integration benefiting over 3.7 crore mothers.

eligibility_criteria.limitations: Women in regular employment with Central or State Government or PSUs or in receipt of similar maternity benefits under other laws are excluded.

required_documents.title: Aadhaar Card of Mother
required_documents.description: UIDAI Aadhaar of mother linked to bank account.

required_documents.title: Mother and Child Protection (MCP) Card
required_documents.description: RCH/MCP card with records of antenatal check-up (ANC) and infant immunization.

required_documents.title: Aadhaar-Seeded Bank Passbook
required_documents.description: Individual bank account details of the mother for DBT.
